# seekrit_application (Resource)

A seekrit application — a container for environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "seekrit_application" "web" {
  name = "Web"
  slug = "web" # immutable: changing it replaces the application
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable application name (editable in place).
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier, unique per org. Immutable — changing it replaces the application.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (ISO 8601).
- `id` (String) Server-generated application id (`app_…`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (ISO 8601).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Applications import by id.
terraform import seekrit_application.web app_2f8Kd1PqRzY
```
